meta.title: Battle Dialogue · A Flash of Thunder
meta.description: In that moment, in all directions, light and dark split.

units.rawText: You will... not touch her!
units.displayText: You will... not touch her!

spans.text: You will... not touch her!

units.rawText: Warning—Warning—Approaching critical threshold. This process is irreversible.
units.displayText: Warning—Warning—Approaching critical threshold. This process is irreversible.

spans.text: Warning—Warning—Approaching critical threshold. This process is irreversible.

units.rawText: Warning—Approaching critical threshold, this process is irreversible!
units.displayText: Warning—Approaching critical threshold, this process is irreversible!

spans.text: Warning—Approaching critical threshold, this process is irreversible!

units.rawText: Atlas ignores the alarms screaming madly into his ears and his wavering body suddenly exerts tremendous strength, slowly forcing Caina back.
units.displayText: Atlas ignores the alarms screaming madly into his ears and his wavering body suddenly exerts tremendous strength, slowly forcing Caina back.

spans.text: Atlas ignores the alarms screaming madly into his ears and his wavering body suddenly exerts tremendous strength, slowly forcing Caina back.

units.rawText: Yes... Yes. Yes! That's it! That's how it should be!!
units.displayText: Yes... Yes. Yes! That's it! That's how it should be!!

spans.text: Yes... Yes. Yes! That's it! That's how it should be!!

units.rawText: Hahahaha, that's more like it! It's a fight, it's a fight! Ptolemaea didn't lie to me after all!
units.displayText: Hahahaha, that's more like it! It's a fight, it's a fight! Ptolemaea didn't lie to me after all!

spans.text: Hahahaha, that's more like it! It's a fight, it's a fight! Ptolemaea didn't lie to me after all!

units.rawText: You really can fight with me! Fight seriously with me!
units.displayText: You really can fight with me! Fight seriously with me!

spans.text: You really can fight with me! Fight seriously with me!

units.rawText: Caina redoubles her efforts, but Atlas actually manages to hold her off.
units.displayText: Caina redoubles her efforts, but Atlas actually manages to hold her off.

spans.text: Caina redoubles her efforts, but Atlas actually manages to hold her off.

units.rawText: <cmdr>!
units.displayText: {교수}!

units.rawText: Atlas turns back to look at me.
units.displayText: Atlas turns back to look at me.

spans.text: Atlas turns back to look at me.

units.rawText: Take Alcyone away. Leave this place to me.
units.displayText: Take Alcyone away. Leave this place to me.

spans.text: Take Alcyone away. Leave this place to me.

units.rawText: I understand his intentions. Given the circumstances, there is only one thing which could cause his damage to recover, his systems to regain their functions, and even become stronger.
units.displayText: I understand his intentions. Given the circumstances, there is only one thing which could cause his damage to recover, his systems to regain their functions, and even become stronger.

spans.text: I understand his intentions. Given the circumstances, there is only one thing which could cause his damage to recover, his systems to regain their functions, and even become stronger.

units.rawText: Atlas is burning himself up.
units.displayText: Atlas is burning himself up.

spans.text: Atlas is burning himself up.

units.rawText: No! Atlas, I'm sorry, don't do this, I'll stay.
units.displayText: No! Atlas, I'm sorry, don't do this, I'll stay.

spans.text: No! Atlas, I'm sorry, don't do this, I'll stay.

units.rawText: Don't, Atlas, let me help you, I'll be right...
units.displayText: Don't, Atlas, let me help you, I'll be right...

spans.text: Don't, Atlas, let me help you, I'll be right...

units.rawText: As her words trail off into incoherency, Alcyone frantically feels around on the ground for her weapon.
units.displayText: As her words trail off into incoherency, Alcyone frantically feels around on the ground for her weapon.

spans.text: As her words trail off into incoherency, Alcyone frantically feels around on the ground for her weapon.

units.rawText: I scoop her up with one arm, then pick up Electra with the other before retreating as fast as I can.
units.displayText: I scoop her up with one arm, then pick up Electra with the other before retreating as fast as I can.

spans.text: I scoop her up with one arm, then pick up Electra with the other before retreating as fast as I can.
...I'm counting on you, Atlas.
They'll be fine.

units.rawText: Yeah, like I said, I'll handle all the enemies.
units.displayText: Yeah, like I said, I'll handle all the enemies.

spans.text: Yeah, like I said, I'll handle all the enemies.

units.rawText: The massive walls shift and obscure my vision, as though they're trapping Atlas in another world.
units.displayText: The massive walls shift and obscure my vision, as though they're trapping Atlas in another world.

spans.text: The massive walls shift and obscure my vision, as though they're trapping Atlas in another world.

units.rawText: Let go of me! <cmdr>! Let go of me! Let me go to him! I want to go to Atlas!
units.displayText: Let go of me! {교수}! Let go of me! Let me go to him! I want to go to Atlas!

spans.text: Let go of me!
! Let go of me! Let me go to him! I want to go to Atlas!

units.rawText: Alcyone.
units.displayText: Alcyone.

spans.text: Alcyone.

units.rawText: I want to help him, I can help him, we can help him.
units.displayText: I want to help him, I can help him, we can help him.

spans.text: I want to help him, I can help him, we can help him.

units.rawText: <size=40>Alcyone!</size>
units.displayText: Alcyone!

spans.text: Alcyone!

units.rawText: I raise my voice and she falls silent.
units.displayText: I raise my voice and she falls silent.

spans.text: I raise my voice and she falls silent.

units.rawText: A moment later, she stops struggling in my arms and begins weeping quietly.
units.displayText: A moment later, she stops struggling in my arms and begins weeping quietly.

spans.text: A moment later, she stops struggling in my arms and begins weeping quietly.

units.rawText: Don't leave him, don't leave him alone... (sob) Please, <cmdr>... don't leave Atlas by himself...
units.displayText: Don't leave him, don't leave him alone... (sob) Please, {교수}... don't leave Atlas by himself...

spans.text: Don't leave him, don't leave him alone... (sob) Please,
... don't leave Atlas by himself...

units.rawText: Yeah. I can rest easy leaving it to you, buddy!
units.displayText: Yeah. I can rest easy leaving it to you, buddy!

spans.text: Yeah. I can rest easy leaving it to you, buddy!
